faqs.question: Which platform do you build on?
faqs.answer: We pick the right foundation — fully custom (Next.js / headless) or a platform like Shopify/WooCommerce — based on your needs, then tailor it to your catalog and operations.

faqs.question: Can it integrate with our systems?
faqs.answer: Yes — payments, shipping, inventory, accounting, and CRM connect into one flow so orders and stock stay in sync.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
